# Electrical faults, grounds and battery drain

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Verify wiring stubs then locate and install an IPDM relay. [t1606]

[Partial] Check the SWR with a meter and tune the antenna in an open area. [t2332]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Verify that the vehicle has wiring stubs for fog lights if they were not factory equipped.
2. [Partial] Locate and install a relay in the IPDM (Intelligent Power Distribution Module) located under the hood.

_Procedure reported by [t1606]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t2332] [Partial]</summary>

1. Check the SWR (Standing Wave Ratio) to determine how much power is turned into signal versus heat.
2. [Partial] Aim for an SWR of 1.0 or lower, as higher numbers indicate more heat generation in the CB electronics.

</details>

## Parts

- [Partial] SWR meter [t2332]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Tune the antenna in an open area for accurate readings. [t2332]
